title: bolbodium quadrangulare
intro: Bolbodium quadrangulare, commonly known as the Chinese squill or Chinese scilla, is a plant species in the family Asparagaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its purported health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Bolbodium quadrangulare are attributed to its ability to clear heat and relieve toxicity, making it a popular remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
